title: Classical Bharat
subtitle: States, knowledge traditions, art and intellectual life
abstract: States, knowledge traditions, art and intellectual life. This article is a foundation for further research in the History section.

sections.title: Classical Bharat
content: This section introduces the period and identifies the principal political, social and cultural developments that shaped the history of Bharat.
The article is intentionally structured as a research gateway; individual themes can be expanded into dedicated monographs.
